sources.title: Maxillary First Molar
sources.author: University of Dundee, School of Dentistry

selection: One genuine left model per anatomical tooth type, with right geometry reflected and independently fitted to the corresponding original right-side reference. Third molars excluded. The existing single-surface prototype supplies upper first molars unchanged.
processing: Remove Sketchfab display normalization, retaining subnode transforms; restore actual reference relationship through source-based registration.
Use cervical color boundary and source crown/arch axes for individual canonical frames. Original projected 33/43 inner cavity is omitted from the exterior render.
Blender 4.5 quadric collapse with original UVs; two independently simplified LODs. Smooth shading normals and MikkTSpace tangents.

Pack thirteen original normal maps and derived enamel-mask/roughness/tone/ambient-visibility maps into two shared texture atlases. 16 local visibility samples at0.65mm on desktop LOD, reused for mobile. No runtime Draco decoder or network textures.
Keep approved FDI26/16 asset separate; do not author a substitute or apply new surface displacement.
limitations: ZBrush teaching reconstructions; the author explicitly identifies CT inputs for the assembly and selected individual models, not every source. No raw clinical scan is claimed.
Cervical ring and tissue parameters inferred from author colors, not measured segmentation or optical properties.
Mirrored left morphology does not retain the individual right-side shape, though actual independently fitted right positions remain asymmetric.
The reference is educational and contains some closed-bite overlaps. A display opening or pose-only clearances do not establish a clinically validated occlusion.
